metadata.title: Holiday Pop Portrait with Glitter Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-key studio portrait of a young male artist featuring a stark white background with snow bokeh and heavy red glitter display typography.
triggerTerms: red glitter text on white background
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-close-up portrait of a young man in a black leather jacket against a bright white, snow-dusted background. The composition is anchored by large, bold, red glitter-textured block lettering at the bottom, overlaid with a white cursive script and a rough red underline.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast black leather against a bright white background
Red glitter texture providing a festive focal point against neutral tones
Soft snow bokeh overlaying the sharp studio portrait
Bold geometric sans-serif paired with fluid, handwritten script
coreInvariants: Red glitter texture within the primary display type
High-key white background with subtle gray drop shadow behind the subject
Snowflake or bokeh particles layered over the entire scene

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, occupying the top two-thirds of the frame from the chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red glitter text at the bottom horizontal third.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down to the vibrant red text, and follow the script across the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space surrounding the head and shoulders to emphasize the silhouette.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value and high contrast; saturation is concentrated exclusively in the red graphic elements.
paletteRestrictions: Vibrant red for the primary text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy geometric sans-serif and casual brush script
letterConstructionRules: Display type uses thick, uniform strokes with sharp corners
Script type mimics fast, hand-drawn white ink with varying pressure
Display type is filled with a multi-tonal red glitter pattern
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are tightly tracked to create a solid block of color
A rough, textured red brush stroke underlines the script
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Superimposed contrast: heavy, textured geometric type behind light, fluid organic script.
graphicDevices: Soft drop shadow behind the subject

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy geometric sans-serif skeleton of the display text.
Captures the casual, handwritten feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio portrait of a young man in a black leather jacket against a white background with a soft gray shadow. Apply a layer of white snow bokeh and sparkles over the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold sans-serif text in the bottom third with a red glitter texture. Overlap this with a white brush-script phrase and a rough red underline.

verificationChecks: Is the red text filled with a glitter/sparkle texture?
Does the white script overlap the red block letters?
Is the background pure white with visible snow particles?
Is the subject wearing a black leather jacket?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the celebrity
Exact brand logos on the jacket

mustAchieve: Balanced layering of text and image

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red glitter is vibrant and not dull.
Ensure the snow particles do not obscure the subject's eyes.
Verify the script text is clearly legible against the glitter background.
Confirm the high-key lighting maintains detail in the black jacket.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + High-Key White + Snow Bokeh + [Glitter Display Type] + [Overlaid Script]
